_meta.note: USC bus schedules below are the Fall 2026 schedule (began Mon Aug 24, 2026). All USC bus services are closed on university holidays (Nov 11, Nov 26-27, 2026). Live positions: ETA SPOT app or uscbuses.etaspot.net (not on allowlist; not integrated).

funding.text: Mandatory Student Transportation Fee: $151 per semester (Fall 2026, Spring 2027; $146 Summer 2026). Funds the Lyft program, USC buses (including LAX shuttles in some breaks) and the Metro U-Pass. Only waiver: active USC employees by primary Workday classification.

lyft.name: USC Lyft Rides Program
lyft.cost_to_student: Free if the ride qualifies (fare quote shows FREE; $0.00 receipt)
lyft.eligibility: Current USC students, faculty and staff

hours.game_day_UPC: Fall home football game days: starts 5 hours after scheduled kickoff or at normal hours, whichever is later (e.g. Sept 26, 4:30 PM kickoff -> 9:30 PM).
hours.other_changes: Hours can change for holidays and periods such as finals week (specific Nov-Dec 2026 changes not posted).

boundary_UPC.rule: Ride must START and END inside the geofence; rides between UPC and HSC are not covered. Geofence polygon itself is not published as data.

ride_limits.per_ride_or_per_month_count: NONE PUBLISHED. The program "runs on limited credits that automatically renew every month"; footnote: "Maximum monthly benefit is $1,000." No per-student ride count is stated.
ride_limits.ride_type: Must choose Shared. Not covered: LUX, priority pickups, scheduled rides, added stops, tips, PrimeTime, cancellation fees. Lyft Business users must ride in PERSONAL mode.
ride_limits.unsafe_cancel: Lyft charges $5 to cancel but waives it if you request through in-app support saying you canceled because you felt unsafe.

how_to_enroll: Open the Lyft app Payment section and look for "USC Lyft Rides" ("HSC USC Rides" at HSC)
If missing, submit the Lyft Invite form on the USC Transportation Lyft page (invites go out the week before each semester)
Do not share the invite; it is single-use
Changed phone number: update it in your existing Lyft account, do not create a new one

University Village area: Cardinal Gardens Apartments (near the Metro stop at McClintock)

lyft.accessibility: Lyft's WAV Rides program for non-collapsible or motorized wheelchairs.

campus_cruiser.status: Suspended (listed by USC Transportation as suspended). The free Lyft program replaces it.

metro.to_LAX: E Line westbound to Expo/Crenshaw, K Line southbound to LAX/Metro Transit Center, then free LAX Metro Connector shuttle (every 10-15 min, 4 AM-1 AM). Or J Line south to Harbor Fwy, then C Line west.

directions_and_headways.note: E Line terminals, train frequency and first/last train times are NOT on any allowed USC page (metro.net is not on the allowlist). The current Trojan Hub labels ("Downtown LA (7th St/Metro)" / "Downtown Santa Monica", every 8/12/20 min) are unverified; since the 2023 Regional Connector the eastbound E Line is generally understood to continue through downtown to East LA (Atlantic) - unverified here, check metro.net.

u_pass.name: Metro U-Pass
u_pass.eligibility: ALL current USC students (graduate and undergraduate)
u_pass.cost: No additional cost (paid by the Transportation Fee)
u_pass.term: Fall 2026 program began Aug 17, 2026 and runs through the beginning of January. Must re-register every semester; keep the same card ("RENEWAL").
valid_on: All LA Metro buses and trains (incl. Metro Rapid)
u_pass.card: A PHYSICAL card issued by USC is required to begin. Pick up at USC Transportation, McCarthy Structure (Mon-Fri 8:30-3:00) at UPC, or KAM-120 (Mon-Fri 7:30-4:00) at HSC. No phone/mobile wallet version is mentioned.
steps: Have a physical USC-issued U-Pass card (pick one up if you do not)
Complete the online U-Pass form on USC Transportation's U-Pass page
Open the LA Metro link in the automatic confirmation email
Enter your 20-digit card number and the activation code shown on the page/email, check the acknowledgement box, click Submit
Tap the card at any Metro station or on a bus within 14 days to lock in the activation (hold until the kiosk beeps)
u_pass.common_failure: Almost every U-Pass issue comes from not tapping within 14 days to lock in activation.
u_pass.note: The per-semester activation code is printed on the public page; it is intentionally not copied here. Show users the official page instead.

metrolink.text: Active students get 50% off Metrolink: download the Metrolink app, register with your school email, choose "Student/Youth" rider type, carry a valid student ID. U-Pass is not valid on Metrolink.

zipcar.program: USC partners with Zipcar for self-service car sharing. Students join FREE for the first year, then $35/year ($55 off standard). 24/7 access; discounted hourly rates for USC faculty, staff and students 18+; gas, insurance and maintenance included. Reserve online/by phone, unlock with the phone (Bluetooth), return to the same spot.
zipcar.locations_note: USC does not list Zipcar pick-up locations on its pages; zipcar.com is not on the allowlist. Current Trojan Hub locations ("Village Structure", "Structure X") and named cars/rates are unverified. USC parking rules confirm marked Zipcar spaces exist ($80 fine for parking in one).
zipcar.enterprise: Enterprise is USC's preferred rental provider, with a dedicated link for USC students 21+.

metro_bike_share.note: At least four stations; discounted student pass available; return to any station (listen for three beeps).

bikes.registration: Free DPS registration is required by USC policy if you ride or park a bike on campus (also scooters/skateboards): submit the online form, then pick up the decal at DPS in Parking Structure A (PSA). Questions: (213) 740-5519.
bikes.parking: Use racks (two locks or a U-lock through frame and rear wheel). USC Village has secure indoor bike parking (built for 1,500+ bikes). USC Transportation publishes an interactive map of racks, repair stations and bike share.
bikes.housing_rule: E-scooters and hoverboards may not be used or kept in university-owned housing.
nearby_shops: Lux's Bicycle Shop, 1305 W Jefferson Blvd

visitor_rates.daily: $20/day (Text2Park +$0.50 one-time fee; Pay-by-Plate no fee), e.g. McCarthy Way Structure
visitor_rates.hourly: $4/hour at Figueroa and USC Shrine structures and Jefferson Structure (after 12 PM); Text2Park up to 4 h, 5+ h charged $20
visitor_rates.game_day: $50 per home football game (all entrances), plus Text2Park fees; cashless
visitor_rates.free_parking: None; USC Transportation FAQ says there is no free parking at USC. Pay-by-Plate/Text2Park areas are enforced 24 h.
